Infobae/EFE 21 Nov: Merz–Macron package struck at Dublin informal summit 12–13 Nov; on 20 Nov DE nominated Markus Brunnermeier (chief economist, replacing Lane, end-May 2027) and FR nominated Laurence Boone (market operations, replacing Schnabel who goes to IMF); Pierrakakis passed names to Costa. NO formal Eurogroup/Council recommendation yet; formal path: Ecofin recommendation (Ecofin 11 Dec) -> EP + ECB opinions -> European Council appointment, targeted 17–18 Dec (Eunews 4 Nov).
